title: Ziyarat of Lady Narjis
intro: The visitation of Lady Narjis, mother of Imam Mahdi, kept separate from the ziyarat of Lady Hakima.
description: Read Ziyarat of Lady Narjis with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
Ziyarah of the Mother of Imam al-Mahdi Lady Nargis Khatoon (sa)

You may then visit the doyenne of this world and the Next World; namely, the mother of Imam al-Qa'im whose tomb is situated behind the tomb of our master Imam al-Hasan al-`Askari (`a).

You should thus say the following words while visiting her tomb:

blocks.english: Peace be upon Allah’s Messenger,
Allah’s blessings be upon him,
the veracious and honest.
Peace be upon our master the Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon the Immaculate Imams
and the blessed Arguments (of Allah).
Peace be upon the mother of the Imam;
the lady entrusted with the secrets of the All-knowing King
and the bearer of the most honorable of all beings.
Peace be upon you, O veracious and well-pleased lady.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا شَبِيهَةَ امِّ مُوسَىٰ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O equivalent of (Prophet) Moses’ mother
and daughter of (Prophet) Jesus’ Disciple.
Peace be upon you, O pious and bright.
Peace be upon you, O well-pleased and well-contented.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ ايَّتُهَا ٱلْمَنْعُوتَةُ فِي ٱلإِنْجِيلِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O described in the Gospel,
betrothed from the Honest Spirit of Allah,

blocks.arabic: وَمَنْ رَغِبَ فِي وُصْلَتِهَا مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa man raghiba fi wuslatiha muhammadun sayyidu almursalina
blocks.english: desired for relationship by Muhammad the chief of the Messenger,
and entrusted with the secrets of the Lord of the Worlds.
Peace be upon you and upon your fathers the Disciples.
Peace be upon you, your husband, and your son.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَىٰ رُوحِكِ وَبَدَنِكِ ٱلطَّاهِرِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki wa `ala ruhiki wa badaniki alttahiri
blocks.english: Peace be upon you and upon your pure spirit and body.
I bear witness that you acted excellently in custody (of your son),
fulfilled the trust,
worked painstakingly for gaining Allah’s pleasure,
acted steadfastly for the sake of Allah,
kept the secret of Allah,
born the representative of Allah,

blocks.transliteration: wa balaghti fi hifzi hujjati allahi
blocks.english: did meticulously in the safeguarding of the Argument of Allah,

blocks.arabic: وَرَغِبْتِ فِي وُصْلَةِ ابْنَاءِ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa raghibti fi wuslati abna'i rasuli allahi
blocks.english: and desired for maintaining the descendants of the Messenger of Allah
as you had full recognition of their rights,
believed in their honesty,
professed their status,
acknowledged their matter,
sympathized with them,
and preceded their inclination to yours.

blocks.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّكِ مَضَيْتِ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ مِنْ امْرِكِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaki madayti `ala basiratin min amriki
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you passed away with full awareness of the truth,
following the examples of the righteous ones,
well-pleased, well-contented,
pious, bright, and pure.
So, may Allah be pleased with you and may He please you

blocks.transliteration: wa ja`ala aljannata manzilaki wa ma'waki
blocks.english: and decide Paradise to be your abode and dwelling.

blocks.arabic: فَلَقَدْ اوْلاَكِ مِنَ ٱلْخَيْرَاتِ مَا اوْلاَكِ
blocks.transliteration: falaqad awlaki min alkhayrati ma awlaki
blocks.english: He has endued you with lots of the good things with which He has bestowed upon you

blocks.arabic: وَاعْطَاكِ مِنَ ٱلشَّرَفِ مَا بِهِ اغْنَاكِ
blocks.transliteration: wa a`taki min alshsharafi ma bihi aghnaki
blocks.english: and He has given you the honorable position that made you dispense with everything else.
May Allah delight and gratify you

blocks.text:
مِنَ ٱلْكَرَامَةِ وَامْرَاكِِ
min alkaramati wa amraki

with the dignity that He has granted you.

You may then raise your head towards the heavens and say the following dua:

blocks.english: O Allah, to You alone have I had recourse.
Your pleasure alone have I sought.
Through Your representatives have I sought means to You.
On Your forgiveness and forbearance have I relied.
By You alone have I held fast.
In the tomb of the mother of Your representative have I taken refuge.
So, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household,
make me benefit by my visit to her,
keep me firm on love for her,
do not deprive me of her intercession
and her son’s intercession,
provide me with being in her companionship,
and include me with the group of her and her son

blocks.transliteration: kama waffaqtani liziyarati waladiha wa ziyaratiha
blocks.english: as You have grant me success to visit her son and her.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ إِِلَيْكَ بِٱلائِمَّةِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma inni atawajjahu ilayka bil-a'immati alttahirina
blocks.english: O Allah, I do turn my face towards You by means of the immaculate Imams
and I choose as my mediation to You the blessed Arguments
from the descendants of Taha and Yasin,

blocks.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ
blocks.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin alttayyibina
blocks.english: (beseeching You) to bless Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household the pure

blocks.transliteration: wa an taj`alani min almutma'innina alfa'izina
blocks.english: and to make me of the tranquil, triumphant,
blissful, and glorious ones

blocks.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ لاََ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
blocks.transliteration: alladhina la khawfun `alayhim wa la hum yahzanuna
blocks.english: on whom there is neither fear nor shall they be aggrieved.
And (please) make me one of those whose deeds are admitted by You,
whose affairs will be made easy by You,
whose distress will be relieved by You,
and whose fear will be secured by You.

blocks.transliteration: allahumma bihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah [I beseech You] in the name of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
(please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي إِِيَّاهَا
blocks.transliteration: wa la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati iyyaha
blocks.english: do not decide this visit to be the last time of my visits to her;

blocks.arabic: وَٱرْزُقْنِي ٱلْعَوْدَ إِِلَيْهَا ابَداً مَا ابْقَيْتَنِي
blocks.transliteration: warzuqni al`awda ilayha abadan ma abqaytani
blocks.english: rather, endue me with other chances to re-visit her as long as You keep me alive.

blocks.transliteration: wa idha tawaffaytani fahshurni fi zumratiha
blocks.english: If You decide to grasp my soul, then (please) include me with her group,

blocks.transliteration: wa adkhilni fi shafa`ati waladiha wa shafa`atiha
blocks.english: bring me in the intercession of her son and her,
forgive me and my parents
as well as the believing men and women,
give us good in this world
and good in the Hereafter,
and save us, out of Your mercy, from the chastisement of Fire.
Peace be upon you all, O my masters.
Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon you.

blocks.text: [1] Misbah uz Zaaer: p. 413; Al Mazar ul Kabeer: p. 660; Al Bihar: 102/70

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت حضرت نرجس خاتون کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
